items.title: Show HN: Benchmarks of continual learning model trained for a month on a laptop
items.contentSnippet:
A month ago, I shared mini-AGI, an experiment in training a byte-level, continually learning language model from scratch on a single 8 GB laptop GPU (an RTX 3070).
To recap the setup briefly: it completely decouples model size from VRAM by paging experts to and from an NVMe drive (currently 397 experts / 1.26B total parameters on disk, with only 32 resident / ~109M active in 5.1 GB of VRAM).
